item.title: perf: opaque page-host canvas windows under headless to cut WindowServer load. Headless canvas windows are opacity 0 (invisible) anyway, so making them opaque instead of transparent keeps the full-...
item.description: perf: opaque page-host canvas windows under headless to cut WindowServer load. Headless canvas windows are opacity 0 (invisible) anyway, so making them opaque instead of transparent keeps the full-screen geometry (bounds round-trip tests pass) while eliminating the per-pixel alpha compositing that saturated macOS WindowServer when many full-screen page-host windows exist at once. Measured WindowServer drop from 56-75 to 38-49 percent in 4-worker session-restore profiling
